0.literal: Damn you... I ain't handin' that woman over...!
0.official: Listen... You're not... gettin' that woman!

1.literal: My buddies'll... come runnin'... any second now...
1.official: More of my boys're... already on their way...

2.literal: You just don't give up, do ya...!

4.literal: It will turn into a fight to protect Makoto.
4.official: If your pursuers spot you and you're caught, you'll have to fight to protect Makoto.

5.literal: In battles with your pursuers, protecting Makoto
5.official: When fighting off pursuers, keeping Makoto safe should be your top priority.

6.literal: should be your top priority as you fight.
6.official: When fighting off pursuers, keeping Makoto safe should be your top priority.

7.literal: While a pursuer is grabbing Makoto to carry her off,
7.official: If they grab hold of her and try to drag her off,

8.literal: Makoto's stamina will drop as she resists.
8.official: she'll spend her energy to resist.

9.literal: If Makoto's stamina hits zero, it's game over, so
9.official: If Makoto loses all her energy, it's game over.

10.literal: For now I got no choice but to head north toward Sotenbori Street!
10.official: Best bet's to get her up north to Sotenbori Street without these bastards seein' her!

12.literal: Damn it, the guys who snatched that woman...
12.official: Crap, which way'd those guys take the girl?

13.literal: There they are! I dunno what they're after, but
13.official: There! I dunno what their endgame is, but gettin' her away from them is priority one.

14.literal: I ain't lettin' you get away...!

15.official: C'mon, no time to drag yer heels!

16.literal: Then I'll just take 'em on one after another, every last one!

17.literal: Y-You were tryin' to do somethin' with that woman?

18.literal: You're a real idiot, you are.

20.literal: we should be able to shake those guys off...!
20.official: we should be able to shake 'em...

22.literal: No time for that! Hold on tight!
22.official: No time for that! Hang on to me tight, now!

23.literal: (...Couldn't get any decent sleep again, huh.)

24.literal: You probably won't find a place this impressive in Kamurocho.
24.official: I don't think there's any place this big up in Kamurocho.

25.literal: I'll go once I've gotten a bit more prepared.

27.literal: The rest is up to you guys to liven up the club.
27.official: Now it's up to you guys to keep this place on the upswing.

28.literal: Even though we sent out a few of our own in the trade,
28.official: Sure, we gave up some of our girls in the trade...

29.literal: Goin' to the club in person was the right call after all.
29.official: Guess it's a good thing I handled it personally.

30.literal: I'm so moved to be working under someone like you...!
30.official: All I can say is that it's an honor to work under a man like you!

31.literal: Looks like my read on the club was on the mark too.
31.official: And I guess the ol' eye didn't let me down once I got there, either.

32.literal: Well, it's like my enemy did me a favor, so I got mixed feelings about it, but...
32.official: Nice surprises are always a little creepy when they're comin' from your enemies, but I'll take it.

33.literal: Hmph, Yamagata, the manager of Odyssey, huh...

35.literal: It looks like they'll bring their customers from their old club right along with them.
35.official: With any luck, they'll bring all their old regulars straight to us.

36.literal: There's no doubt the terms are in our favor.
36.official: there's no denying we came out on top here.

37.literal: Well, I did prep a fair bit before I went.
37.official: Well, I did a fair bit of research beforehand.

38.literal: The name "Lord of the Night" really isn't just for show!
38.official: It's no wonder they call you the Lord of the Night!

39.literal: Well, no use sayin' it now. I'll call it good.
39.official: No sense worryin' about it now, though.

41.literal: I see. Well, then it was worth goin' over there.
41.official: Yeah? Glad I hauled my ass over there, then.

42.literal: I wish I coulda made the deal on better terms.
42.official: Honestly, though, I was hopin' we'd make out a little better than what we got.

43.literal: Now then, let's get right to the shifts...
43.official: Now, if this is a good time, I'd like to work out the new shift schedule.

44.official: The hell kinda stunt is this?

45.literal: I'd sooner drink my own piss.
45.official: Sorry, but I'd rather down a hot mug of my own piss than suffer through beers with you.

46.literal: I'll be waiting at Ashitaba Park. Hurry up and get there.
46.official: I'll meet you in Ashitaba Park. Don't keep me waiting, yeah?

47.literal: I'll let the chief know as well.
47.official: I'll let the floor manager know.

48.literal: ...a chance for me to make my comeback as a yakuza.
48.official: My big chance to get back to the yakuza life.

49.literal: There's still time. Rushin' it and screwin' up would be the worst.
49.official: I still got time. Absolute worst thing I can do is rush it and screw up.

50.literal: I'll start makin' moves in earnest tomorrow, and
50.official: I'll start tomorrow, do it right.

51.literal: How'm I s'posed to enjoy a drink with you sittin' next to me?
51.official: Sake don't taste right sittin' next to you.

52.literal: Heh, has it been two years already? That you and I have known each other?
52.official: Heh, has it already been two years since you and I met?

53.literal: And yet that rebellious streak of yours still hasn't changed.
53.official: All that time, and you're still sulking.

54.official: Makes me wonder why my oath brother even bothers keeping you alive.

55.literal: Expulsion, severing ties... those are the lucky outcomes, but
55.official: Expelled, disavowed... That's if they're lucky.

56.literal: sometimes you get tortured to death.
56.official: Worst case, you disappear into some black site for a nice, slow death.

58.literal: It's unbelievable how tough you were to endure it, but
58.official: How you made it through that without cracking's a mystery,

59.literal: that Shimano of all people would save you...
59.official: but why he brought somebody back from the hole is even harder to figure out.

60.literal: But that doesn't mean Shimano forgave you.
60.official: But getting let out and forgiveness aren't the same.

61.literal: You were banished from the yakuza world.
61.official: You were banished from the life without a proper expulsion OR disavowal.

62.literal: And then he left you in the care of me, his sworn brother under a different crest,
62.official: And now Shimano's punted you to me, his brother flying other colors.

63.literal: Why Shimano, known as a hardliner, would go to such...
63.official: For a guy known to talk straight or with his fists, Shimano sure picked a weird, roundabout way to deal with you.
